name: Kraken BTC/USD one-, five-, and fifteen-minute momentum
description: Causal simple basis-point returns of the fresh Kraken displayed best-quote midpoint over one-, five-, and fifteen-minute horizons on the one-second midpoint ring. direction_5m is down, flat, or up from the full-precision five-minute return. Any missing or non-ready one-second observation breaks continuity and restarts the fifteen-minute warm-up; the identity is ready only once the ring holds 901 contiguous one-second samples (the longest horizon, 15 minutes). This is a longer-horizon companion to the micro identities and never widens the existing micro_momentum contract (SME contract stability). Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even. This identity is single-venue: it reads only Kraken inputs and is ready whenever the Kraken midpoint ring holds 901 contiguous one-second samples, independently of the other adopted spot venues. The blended btc.external.* reading of the same measurement keeps its every-venue AND-gate and stays the reference layer (ADR 0024).
